summary: Completed testing of bulk episode editing feature. Both backend API (POST /api/creator/series/{id}/bulk-edit-episodes) and frontend UI (selection mode, bulk actions bar) are fully functional. All 3 actions (set_free, set_coins, move_season) work correctly via API. Frontend shows Bulk Edit button, checkboxes replace drag handles in selection mode, bulk actions bar appears with Make Free/Make Paid/Move to Season options.

tests.test: set_free action with value=true - set 2 episodes to FREE
set_coins action with value=10 - set price to 10 coins
move_season action with value=2 - move episode to Season 2
Episode code updates correctly after move (S01E03 -> S02E01)
is_free flag changes correctly
coins_required updates correctly
season_number updates correctly after move
Bulk Edit button visible with CheckCircle icon
Clicking Bulk Edit enables selection mode
Checkboxes appear instead of drag handles in selection mode
Select All button visible in selection mode
Cancel button visible in selection mode
Clicking episode shows green checkmark
Bulk Actions Bar appears when episodes selected
Move to Season dropdown present
Make Free button present
Make Paid button present
Coins input with placeholder=5 present
Selection counter shows correct count (e.g., '3 selected')
Cancel exits selection mode
